findings.value: A restaurant and bar with an izakaya-inspired menu, open seven nights a week, which also runs a ticketed jazz night called Played Twice.

evidence.quote: Our menu takes inspiration from the izakaya of Japan
We are open seven nights a week.
Played Twice is a ticketed jazz night we run as often as we can.

findings.value: Ticketed listening nights where a jazz record is played seated, then a band plays live versions of it.

evidence.quote: It’s a seated playback of a timeless jazz record on the best pressing we can find
followed by a live interpretation of that music by a band of musicians

notes: Its own site (food, Played Twice and dates pages) was read. The Played Twice page links to two reviews, which were not followed: page_text gives only the text, and WebSearch budget was used up, so the press reviews are still to be checked. Its /dates page lists a name for each night but never says DJ, so no DJ-night claim is made. The address is not on any page read here, so the summary does not give one.
